body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> WowWee presented its ''MS Media'' robot for delivering multi-media service during CES 2007.
It features a 1.9-inch color LCD screen, a motion tracking camera, 11-watts speakers and 40 MB flash memory. It also has 2 microphones for sound localization and 1 microphone for mp3 recording.
